title.target: Business English: reports and executive summaries
title.en: Business English: reports and executive summaries

ex.t: The report begins with an executive summary.
The sales forecast for next year is bright.
Sales are on an upward trend.
We identified the main risk factors.

title.ko: 비즈니스 영어: executive summary · key findings · recommend · forecast · stakeholders · actionable
title.en: business English: executive summary, key findings, recommend, forecast, stakeholders, actionable

explain.ko: 비즈니스 보고서는 결론을 먼저 말합니다. 경영진 요약(executive summary)은 바쁜 의사결정자가 핵심을 빠르게 파악하도록 주요 발견(key findings), 위험(risk factors), 권고(We recommend ...), 후속 조치(next steps)를 간결하게 담습니다. 권고는 실행 가능(actionable)하도록 구체적으로 쓰고, 숫자와 근거를 함께 제시하며, 후속 조치에는 담당자와 기한을 포함합니다.
explain.en: A business report gives its conclusion first. The executive summary helps busy decision-makers grasp the core quickly by concisely containing key findings, risk factors, recommendations (We recommend ...) and next steps. Write recommendations specifically so that they are actionable, present figures and evidence together, and include the person responsible and the deadline in next steps.

head: 항목 / Item
표현 / Expression
예 / Example
rows: The key finding is that sales rose.

notes.en: Recommendations must be specific and actionable.
Include owner and deadline in next steps.

lines.t: What goes into an executive summary?

options: Key findings, risks, recommendations and next steps.

lines.t: How should recommendations in a report be written?
What is the key finding of the report?
Sales have risen for three consecutive quarters.
Raw material prices are the main risk factor.

lines.t: An executive summary helps busy decision-makers grasp the essence of a report quickly. It concisely contains key findings, risks, recommendations and next steps, and recommendations must be specific enough to be actionable. Presenting figures and evidence together raises persuasiveness.

trans.ko: 경영진 요약은 바쁜 의사결정자가 보고서의 핵심만 빠르게 파악하도록 돕습니다. 주요 발견, 위험, 권고, 후속 조치를 간결하게 담고, 권고는 실행 가능하게 구체적으로 써야 합니다. 숫자와 근거를 함께 제시하면 설득력이 높아집니다.

items.passage:
MANAGEMENT GUIDE
The marks of a good report
A good report gives its conclusion first. Put the key findings and recommendations in the executive summary, and explain the evidence in detail in the body. At the end, present next steps that include the person responsible and the deadline.

trans.ko:
경영 가이드
좋은 보고서의 조건
좋은 보고서는 결론을 먼저 말합니다. 경영진 요약에는 주요 발견과 권고를 담고, 본문에서 근거를 자세히 설명합니다. 마지막에는 담당자와 기한이 포함된 후속 조치를 제시하세요.

questions.q: What does a good report give first?

options: The person responsible and the deadline

items.passage: The guide says a good report gives its conclusion first. The guide says to put only evidence in the executive summary. The guide says next steps should include the person responsible and the deadline.

trans.ko: 가이드는 좋은 보고서가 결론을 먼저 말한다고 본다. 가이드는 경영진 요약에 근거만 담으라고 한다. 가이드는 후속 조치에 담당자와 기한을 포함하라고 한다.

questions.q: The guide says a good report gives its conclusion first.

expressions.t: The executive summary should capture the essence of the report on one page.
expressions.ko: 경영진 요약은 보고서의 핵심을 한 쪽에 담아야 합니다.

expressions.ko: 주요 발견은 매출이 3분기 연속 상승했다는 것입니다.

expressions.t: The sales forecast for next year is optimistic.
The main risk factor is the price of raw materials.
Results must be shared with stakeholders regularly.
The report should end with actionable proposals.
expressions.ko: 보고서는 실행 가능한 제안으로 끝나야 합니다.

expressions.t: Next steps should list the person responsible and the deadline.
expressions.ko: 후속 조치는 담당자와 기한을 함께 적어야 합니다.

prompt.ko: 경영진 요약 형식으로 발견, 위험, 권고, 후속 조치를 4문장으로 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write four sentences in executive-summary style covering a finding, a risk, a recommendation and next steps.

task.model: The key finding is that sales have risen for three consecutive quarters. The main risk factor is raw material prices. We recommend diversifying suppliers. As next steps, the person responsible should submit a plan by next month.

model_trans.ko: 주요 발견은 매출이 3분기 연속 상승했다는 것입니다. 주요 위험 요소는 원자재 가격입니다. 우리는 공급처 다변화를 권고합니다. 후속 조치로 다음 달까지 담당자가 계획을 제출해야 합니다.
model_trans.en: The key finding is that sales have risen for three consecutive quarters. The main risk factor is raw material prices. We recommend diversifying suppliers. As next steps, the person responsible should submit a plan by next month.
